title: List.Perm is preserved by swapping an append's operands
statement: For any two lists l1, l2 over Nat, List.Perm (List.append l1 l2) (List.append l2 l1) computes to true.

formal.statement: ((x0 : List.{0} AxNat) -> ((x1 : List.{0} AxNat) -> Eq.{1} Bool (List.Perm (List.append AxNat x0 x1) (List.append AxNat x1 x0)) Bool.true))
